summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Ledger Sentinel finance analyzer. 10/10 pytest cases pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering health, upload, listing, retrieval, benign Q&A, harmful-query guardrail, and on-disk PII masking artifacts. UI verified end-to-end via Playwright: badges, dropzone, documents list, populated 12-row transactions table with category pills and PII pill (••••ACCT), and chat panel returning a grounded answer with chunk citations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside upload_pdf/list_documents handlers (logger.exception) but the logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(...) lines are at the very bottom of the module after the routes. Because module-level code executes top-to-bottom and the route bodies only run on request, this works at runtime, but it's brittle - move logger initialization above the route definitions.
Dashboard.jsx is 663 lines - consider splitting into Header / UploadCard / DocumentsList / TransactionsTable / ChatPanel sub-components for maintainability (>700 line guideline almost breached).

PIIMiddleware._ACCT_RE matches any 8-17 digit run; this is greedy and may flag long order/invoice numbers as accounts. Consider a context-aware filter (e.g., near 'Account' / 'Acct' tokens) to reduce false positives, though for redaction-leaning safety this is acceptable.

server.py upload_pdf swallows graph exceptions and stores the document with empty transactions plus graph_error - good UX, but the API still returns HTTP 200 with transaction_count=0; consider returning 207/202 or surfacing graph_error in the response so the UI can warn the user.
test_credentials: n/a - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /app/backend/data/sample_statement.pdf via /api/finance/upload during test fixture (module-scoped). Produces a doc with 12 transactions, 4 PII hits, and persists masked markdown under /app/backend/data/meta/<doc_id>.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_finance_api.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. The upload fixture is module-scoped to avoid spending the Emergent budget on multiple Gemini calls; tests gracefully skip with pytest.skip on 'Budget has been exceeded' responses. Public URL: https://pii-safe-statements.preview.emergentagent.com. To rerun: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_finance_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend data-testids verified: app-header, badge-pii, badge-safety, badge-llm, upload-pdf-dropzone, upload-pdf-input, documents-list, document-item-<id>, summary-<label>, transactions-card, transactions-table, tx-row-<i>, chat-panel, chat-history, suggested-question, chat-msg-user, chat-msg-ai, chat-input, chat-submit-button.
